summary: The guide page adheres strictly to its outline, scope boundaries, and research sources. Factual citations to the ISO/IAF Auditing Practices Group guidance on reviewing and closing nonconformities and the NIST RPD-G-08 corrective action procedure are accurately represented with required contextual disclaimers. The four subsections cover connecting actions to causes, assigning owners and deadlines, handling delays, and recording implementation evidence without overstepping into effectiveness review or prior stages. Hypothetical examples featuring the unnamed machining manufacturer scenario are consistently labeled across all subsections, and no unassigned FAQ section is present.

glossary.definition: Action to eliminate a detected nonconformity (ISO 9000 as quoted in the ISO/IAF APG paper).
Action to eliminate the cause of a nonconformity and prevent recurrence.
Follow-up evidence check that a corrective action prevented recurrence before closure.
The ability to reconstruct the complete chronological history of a finding, including containment, cause, actions, approvals, and effectiveness evidence.
